chunks: "Indeed, the one who consumes the wealth of an orphan will be overtaken by the consequence of that in this world and the Hereafter. As for in this world, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says:
'And let those fear who, if they left behind weak offspring, would fear for them; so let them be wary of Allah.'
And as for in the Hereafter, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says:
'Indeed, those who consume the wealth of orphans unjustly are only consuming fire into their bellies, and they shall enter a Blaze.'

key_terms.مَالِ الْيَتِيمِ: the property or wealth belonging to an orphan
key_terms.وَبَالُ: the harmful consequence or grave outcome

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about consuming the wealth of orphans?
ai.summary: This hadith warns that consuming an orphan's wealth brings consequences in both this world and the Hereafter. It reinforces the Qur'anic command to fear Allah regarding the vulnerable and emphasizes the severe punishment for injustice against orphans.
